data.name: BeebleSwitchXVideoEdit
data.description: Edit a video with Beeble SwitchX. Switches anything in the scene (background, lighting, costume) while preserving the original subject's pixels and motion. Provide a reference image and/or text prompt to describe the new look. Max 240 frames, max ~2.77MP per frame.

data.name: Flux3TextToVideoNode
data.description: Generates a video with synchronized audio from a text prompt via FLUX 3.

data.name: Flux3ImageToVideoNode
data.description: Animates 1 to 10 images with FLUX 3. Each image becomes a frame of the clip: one image opens it, two morph from the first to the second, and more are spread across it or pinned to times you choose.

data.name: Flux3VideoContinuationNode
data.description: Continues a video with FLUX 3: the new clip carries on from the final frames of the one you provide.

data.name: FluxVideoUpscaleNode
data.description: Upscales a video 1.5 to 3 times with FLUX super-resolution, either preserving the source precisely or creatively enhancing its detail.

data.name: FluxVideoEditNode
data.description: Edits a clip from a written instruction: remove, add or replace objects, change the setting, restyle the footage, change on-screen text, or replace the spoken dialogue. Length, framing, camera motion and audio come from the source clip.

data.name: BriaRemoveVideoBackground
data.description: Remove the background from a video using Bria.

data.name: BriaVideoGreenScreen
data.description: Replace a video's background with a solid chroma-key screen using Bria.

data.name: BriaVideoReplaceBackground
data.description: Replace a video's background with a supplied image or video using Bria. The output keeps the foreground's resolution and frame rate; a background with a different aspect ratio is stretched to fit, so match it for undistorted results.

data.name: BriaVideoEraser
data.description: Erase whatever a per-frame mask covers from a video with Bria and fill the gap in. The mask must be white on what should go and black elsewhere. Bria accepts clips of at most 5.1 seconds at 20 to 30 frames per second with even pixel dimensions; audio is kept by default. The returned clip can be a few frames shorter than the input.

data.name: ByteDanceTextToVideoNode
data.description: Generate video using ByteDance models via api based on prompt

data.name: ByteDanceImageToVideoNode
data.description: Generate video using ByteDance models via api based on image and prompt

data.name: ByteDanceFirstLastFrameNode
data.description: Generate video using prompt and first and last frames.

data.name: ByteDance2TextToVideoNode
data.description: Generate video using Seedance 2.5 or 2.0 models based on a text prompt.

data.name: ByteDance2FirstLastFrameNode
data.description: Generate video using Seedance 2.5 or 2.0 from a first frame image and optional last frame image.

data.name: ByteDance2ReferenceNodeV2
data.description: Generate, edit, or extend video using Seedance 2.5 or 2.0 with reference images, videos, and audio. Supports multimodal reference, video editing, and video extension.

data.name: ByteDanceVideoEnhanceNode
data.description: Upscales and restores a video with ByteDance vCube: super-resolution up to 8K, compression artifact and noise removal, colour and sharpness enhancement, optional frame interpolation.

data.name: GeminiVideoOmniV2
data.description: Generate a video with audio from a text prompt using Google's Gemini Omni Flash models. Optionally provide reference images and/or videos to guide or edit the result. Describe the desired length (3-10s) directly in the prompt.

data.name: GrokVideoNode
data.description: Generate video from a prompt or an image

data.name: GrokVideoReferenceNode
data.description: Generate video guided by reference images, with optional preset voice references.

data.name: GrokVideoEditNode
data.description: Edit an existing video based on a text prompt.

data.name: GrokVideoExtendNode
data.description: Extend an existing video with a seamless continuation based on a text prompt.

data.name: HeyGenTalkingPhotoNode
data.description: Animate any image of a person into a lip-synced talking video (HeyGen Avatar IV). Drive it with a text script or your own audio.

data.name: HeyGenAvatarVideoNode
data.description: Generate a talking-presenter video from a HeyGen avatar. Includes HeyGen's most popular public avatars; any look ID can be supplied as an override.

data.name: HeyGenVideoTranslateNode
data.description: Translate a spoken video into another language. Clones the original speaker's voice and re-animates the mouth to match the translated speech.

data.name: HitPawVideoEnhance
data.description: Upscale low-resolution videos to high resolution, eliminate artifacts and noise. Prices shown are per second of video.

data.name: KlingTextToVideoNode
data.description: Kling Text to Video Node

data.name: KlingStartEndFrameNode
data.description: Generate a video sequence that transitions between your provided start and end images. The node creates all frames in between, producing a smooth transformation from the first frame to the last.

data.name: KlingLipSyncAudioToVideoNode
data.display_name: Kling Lip Sync Video with Audio
data.description: Kling Lip Sync Audio to Video Node. Syncs mouth movements in a video file to the audio content of an audio file. When using, ensure that the audio contains clearly distinguishable vocals and that the video contains a distinct face. The audio file should not be larger than 5MB. The video file should not be larger than 100MB, should have height/width between 720px and 1920px, and should be between 2s and 10s in length.

data.name: KlingLipSyncTextToVideoNode
data.display_name: Kling Lip Sync Video with Text
data.description: Kling Lip Sync Text to Video Node. Syncs mouth movements in a video file to a text prompt. The video file should not be larger than 100MB, should have height/width between 720px and 1920px, and should be between 2s and 10s in length.

data.name: KlingOmniProTextToVideoNode
data.description: Use text prompts to generate videos with the latest Kling model.

data.name: KlingOmniProFirstLastFrameNode
data.description: Use a start frame, an optional end frame, or reference images with the latest Kling model.

data.name: KlingOmniProImageToVideoNode
data.description: Use up to 7 reference images to generate a video with the latest Kling model.

data.name: KlingOmniProVideoToVideoNode
data.description: Use a video and up to 4 reference images to generate a video with the latest Kling model.

data.name: KlingOmniProEditVideoNode
data.description: Edit an existing video with the latest model from Kling.

data.name: KlingTextToVideoWithAudio
data.display_name: Kling 2.6 Text to Video with Audio

data.name: KlingImageToVideoWithAudio
data.display_name: Kling 2.6 Image(First Frame) to Video with Audio

data.name: KlingVideoNode
data.description: Generate videos with Kling V3. Supports text-to-video and image-to-video with optional storyboard multi-prompt and audio generation.

data.name: KlingFirstLastFrameNode
data.description: Generate videos with Kling V3 using first and last frames.

data.name: KlingAvatarNode
data.description: Generate broadcast-style digital human videos from a single photo and an audio file.

data.name: LtxApi25TextToVideo
data.description: Professional-quality videos with customizable duration and resolution.

data.name: LtxApi25ImageToVideo
data.description: Professional-quality videos with customizable duration and resolution based on start image.

data.name: LtxApi25AudioToVideo
data.description: Generate a video driven by an audio track, with an optional first frame image.

data.name: LumaVideoNode
data.description: Generates videos synchronously based on prompt and output_size.

data.name: LumaImageToVideoNode
data.description: Generates videos synchronously based on prompt, input images, and output_size.

data.name: LumaRay32TextToVideoNode
data.description: Generate a video from a text prompt using Luma's Ray 3.2 model.

data.name: LumaRay32ImageToVideoNode
data.description: Generate a video from a start and/or end frame using Luma's Ray 3.2 model. Image-anchored generations are always 5 seconds.

data.name: LumaRay32KeyframesToVideoNode
data.description: Generate a video that interpolates through a sequence of guide images, each anchored to a position on the timeline, using Luma Ray 3.2. Build the sequence with Luma Ray 3.2 Keyframe nodes (at least 2).

data.name: LumaRay32VideoEditNode
data.description: Re-render an existing video under a new prompt using Luma Ray 3.2 (restyle, relight, add or remove elements) while keeping the original motion. Source video up to 18 seconds; the edited video keeps the source's length.

data.name: LumaRay32VideoReframeNode
data.description: Change the aspect ratio of an existing video, using Luma Ray 3.2 to fill the newly exposed canvas areas. Source video up to 30 seconds. Billed per second of output.

data.name: LumaRay32ExtendVideoNode
data.description: Extend a previous Ray 3.2 generation forward (continue after it) or backward (lead-in before it). Connect the generation_id output of a prior Luma Ray 3.2 node. Extensions are always 5 seconds.
